newsitem.title: USA: Bridger 550 MW unit 4 on-line, unit 1 restarting.
newsitem.headline: Bridger 550 MW unit 4 on-line, unit 1 restarting.

text.p: The 550 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Jim Bridger coal-fired power plant in Wyoming was back on-line, while the plant's 550 MW unit 1 was in the process of restarting, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Wednesday.
Unit 4 had been down for planned maintenance since late last month, while unit 1 was taken off-line Monday for unplanned repairs.
The plant's 550 MW unit 2 is scheduled to shut Friday for maintenance work through the end of May, while a fourth 550 MW unit continues to operate normally, the sources said.
The Bridger plant is owned by PacifiCorp and Idaho Power Co..
